## Parts

- New IPDM: A component Nissan introduced in 2009 that differs from earlier model years but maintains similar intake routing characteristics. [t661]
- Volant C-Air Intake: Two designs exist: one with a sealed box and another, 09+ featuring a hole cut in the top to avoid relocating horns. [t661]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] This modification was made specifically so owners did not have to relocate their horn assembly. [t661]
- Note that this design is considered 'rubbish' if a snorkel kit is desired later. [t661]
- The text implies that despite minor changes, the '05-'08 style intake works identically in later model years. [t661]
